summary: Review stage. The root cause of DEF-FLISR-7 is confirmed and safe to act on, with a scope correction. The restoration loop in build_plan (flisr.py:91-122, via _nodes_restored_by at 136-151) never excludes a tie whose pick-up set contains a faulted-section node, and capacity is the only gate. The trigger is wider than the 'downstream tail tie' framing: a tie on either endpoint of the faulted section back-feeds it, even when a non-tie switch also bounds that end. On 500 seeded feeders with ties on any node, 194/194 closed ties on faulted nodes back-fed (130 of them non-tail) and 0/306 others did, so explore prediction 2 does not generalise. The fail-safe fix shape is to refuse that tie; patched in-process it gives 0/500 back-fed, and the shipped default plan is unchanged. Severity Sev 0. The only caller is POST /flisr/plan; the only affected requirement id is DEF-FLISR-7. Protected path, two human reviewers required.
